title: The best!!
text: Lucas is literally the best! We are beginners and he was very patient with us. He taught us how to use the mountain bikes properly and his primary concern for us with safety and making sure we were Okay. He was so helpful. This was honestly the best tour. I definitely would do it again and I highly recommend it to everybody!!!
author: Ari_A

title: The best tour I did in Spain!!
text: We spent a beautiful afternoon with Lucas, with friends, on E-bike, we got to know all of Granada, having fun, learning and enjoying the activity and the landscapes to the fullest. Highly recommended, don't miss it!!
author: marian l

title: Route 10/10

title: Great experience! Highly recommended
text: Very good organization. Welcoming guide and knew how to adapt to my level. Very beautiful rides overlooking Granada. I highly recommend!
author: Dodooct

title: A fun romp
text: Lots of great views and a great guide (Luca).  He seems to love the city as much as he loves mountain biking and is very easy to go with, and he keeps it entertaining and informative especially if you ask any questions!
author: Zackary_T

title: The best way to explore the mountains surrounding Granada!
text: We had such a great time on our e-mtb ride with Fabricio. The e-mtb allowed us to see several miles of beautiful trails and views around Granada during the duration of our tour. Fabricio was a great guide, tailoring the trip to our abilities and taking us through several nice areas with few tourists. We are intermediate - advanced riders and he was able to take us through trails that excites us. Bikes were in great condition and made for a great adventure.
author: Roving572799

title: A must if you like adventure and an authentic experience in Granada
text: We had the most incredible time on our EMTB tour with Lucas, our guide. This was our first time E-mountain biking and Lucas was incredibly patient and adapted the course to suit our skill level. The tour contained lots of beautiful and hidden views of the city of Granada, and an off-the-beaten track experience that made you feel like a local than a tourist. The best part about the tour was Lucas's encouraging and warm personality, and impressive knowledge of Granada (as well as his amazing MTB skills). Thanks so much for an incredible tour, Lucas.
